{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Reload data to ensure clean state
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999999.99'
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()

print(f'Number of rows with revenue = 999999.99: {qa_count}')

# Check the status of these QA rows
temp_df = df[qa_mask]
print('\nStatus of QA rows:')
print(temp_df['status'].value_counts(dropna=False))"}
